references.text: First mention of the Nephilim (giants) in the Bible, showing that this was a known group before the Flood
Moses recounts how the spies reported on the large people (sons of Anak) who made the Israelites afraid
Description of the descendants of Anak (the Anakites), who were a great and tall people, counted among the giants
Reference to the Anakites as a great and tall people whom the Israelites feared
Joshua destroyed the Anakites from the hill country, and only a few remained in the cities of the Philistines
Caleb drove out the three Anakites from Hebron: Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai
Earlier in the same chapter, Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, descendants of Anak, are mentioned as living in Hebron
Isaiah describes people as grasshoppers in comparison to God, similar to the image the spies used about themselves
